explanations.headline: No. 10’s run dragged defender from pass spot

claims.text: North London Red’s No. 10 ran 14.5 metres without touching the ball, pulling a defender away from the pass spot.
This opened much more space for a teammate to get the ball in the central penalty area.

explanations.headline: H10's run pulls A6 away, creating space for a shot

claims.text: H10 moved 14.5 metres off the ball, pulling marker A6 who moved 9.6 metres closely matching H10’s run direction.
As a result, A6’s distance to the receiving zone increased from 5.0 to 11.1 metres, freeing more space around that zone.
This added space grew by 309 m², allowing the pass recipient in the central penalty area to shoot 2.2 seconds after the pass.

explanations.headline: H10's off-ball run increased space at pass reception

claims.text: At 6.0 seconds, H10 ran 14.5 metres off-ball, dragging marker A6 who moved 9.6 metres with a movement correlation of 0.99 cosine similarity.
A6's distance to the target zone increased from 5.0 to 11.1 metres during the run, enlarging the space for the teammate receiving the ball.
The free space around the reception zone grew by 309 square metres, from 78 to 387 square metres, with an overall detector confidence of 0.9 and a free space confidence of 1.0.
The nearest defender was 11.1 metres from the reception zone when the pass was played at 6.0 seconds, and 2.2 seconds later a shot occurred without H10 touching the ball.

explanations.headline: No. 8 and No. 6 cut out two defenders

claims.text: North London Red's No. 8 passed to No. 6, who returned the ball cutting out two defenders before the shot.

explanations.headline: One-two pass sequence bypassed two opponents and advanced attack

claims.text: Player H8 started the attack with a pass at 2.4 seconds, followed by player H6 returning a line-breaking pass at 3.1 seconds that bypassed two opponents, A10 and A11.
This one-two sequence involved three passes from the origin to the shot and progressed the ball 24 metres toward the goal.
The chance began 5.8 seconds before the shot, with the key pass starting 3.6 seconds before the final assist.

explanations.headline: One-two sequence initiated by H8 bypassed opponents and led to a shot

claims.text: At 2.4 seconds, H8 played the origin pass of a one-two sequence with 0.78 confidence.
The line-breaking return pass from H6 to H8 at 3.1 seconds bypassed two opponents, A10 and A11.
From the origin pass to the shot, the team made three passes and progressed 24.0 metres toward the goal.
The chance started 5.8 seconds before the shot and 3.6 seconds before the final pass.
